personality_one_liner: A clean, high-trust, and tactile mobile ERP & POS system built specifically for Indonesian LPG gas, branded gallon, and water refill depot distribution businesses.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with clear module separation. Form inputs and card lists use 12-16pt padding. Primary sticky CTAs are pinned in the lower third with safe area clearance.

do's: Use frosted glass headers over scrolling order lists and inventory feeds
Use glass backing on sticky bottom checkout summary action bar
Pair blur with ≥75% surface background tint for guaranteed text readability
dont's: Do not apply blur to input text boxes or dense ledger tables
Do not use multi-color or purple glass filters
Do not stack more than 2 blurred surfaces per screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Strict Color Discipline: Strictly adhere to Botanical Emerald / Deep Forest Green (#047857 / #065F46) brand tokens and Slate (#0F172A / #F8FAFC) neutrals. Under no circumstances use banned hues (indigo, purple, violet, navy blue).
Max Font Weight 500: Never exceed font-weight 500 across all UI elements. Use size and color contrast (e.g. 24pt display vs 14pt body) to create visual hierarchy instead of heavy bold weights.

B2B Gas & Gallon Specific UX: Always account for the 'Tukar Tabung/Galon' (empty container swap) vs 'Beli Baru + Isi' (new cylinder purchase) flow in POS and stock tracking. Every LPG / Gallon sale impacts both liquid/gas inventory and physical container asset counts.
Dual-Status Inventory Display: Display both 'Isi' (Full) and 'Kosong' (Empty) counts for returnable assets on cards and POS item pickers.

Sticky Bottom CTA with Safe Area: All primary actions (Bayar Sekarang, Simpan Transaksi, Rekonsiliasi Selesai) must be pinned in a sticky footer in the lower third with safe area insets to guarantee effortless thumb reach.

Role-Aware Navigation: Provide dynamic bottom tab views or access control for Pemilik (all menus + P&L), Kasir (POS, Pelanggan, Kas Harian), Admin Gudang (Stok, Surat Jalan), and Driver (Surat Jalan Saya, Setoran Kas & Tabung).

Digital Receipts & WhatsApp Trigger: Ensure the POS confirmation modal has a 1-tap 'Kirim Struk via WhatsApp' action formatted with clear transaction details, payment method, and container return balance in Rupiah (Rp).
